title: Collision Repair Tracking Log
subtitle: Collision Repair: preserves changes and next triggers.
description: Collision Repair Tracking Log covers damaged vehicle area, structural or restraint concern, repair plan, supplement, refinish operation, and calibration need. The collision repair coordinator records Collision Repair events, owners, exceptions, and next triggers. Collision Repair Tracking Log keeps Collision Repair exceptions visible until the collision repair coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Collision Repair Tracking Log at intake area, body bay, frame or measurement area, refinish area, and delivery point. Document damaged vehicle area, structural or restraint concern, repair plan, supplement, refinish operation, and calibration need identity before Collision Repair begins. Compare damaged vehicle area, structural or restraint concern, repair plan, supplement, refinish operation, and calibration need findings with stated Collision Repair criteria; route unresolved Collision Repair issues to qualified collision and structural repair reviewer. For Collision Repair Tracking Log, confirm requirements for Collision Repair. Ask qualified collision and structural repair reviewer to review Collision Repair conditions beyond the collision repair coordinator's role.

sections.title: Tracking review and responsible owner
sections.guidance: For Collision Repair, identify responsible parties, intake area, body bay, frame or measurement area, refinish area, and delivery point, and the linked damaged vehicle area, structural or restraint concern, repair plan, supplement, refinish operation, and calibration need source.

sections.title: Tracking review and variance evidence
sections.guidance: Capture Collision Repair facts for damaged vehicle area, structural or restraint concern, repair plan, supplement, refinish operation, and calibration need; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Collision Repair tracked controls
items: Body, structural, suspension, restraint, and glass concern
Part type, fit, corrosion protection, and refinish process
Scan, calibration, alignment, and system verification
Quality, appearance, function, and final safety review

sections.title: Tracking exception, status, and next update
sections.guidance: Reconcile the latest Collision Repair event before closeout. Collision Repair Coordinator identifies overdue action, the responsible party, and the event that reopens review.

blocks.label: Status exceptions, overdue actions, and retained evidence
items: Part, weld, refinish, and corrosion-protection trace
Scan, calibration, alignment, and final inspection evidence
blocks.guidance: Pause Collision Repair when structural, restraint, repair-method, calibration, alignment, or final safety verification remains unresolved. Retain the available Collision Repair proof and route unresolved damaged vehicle area, structural or restraint concern, repair plan, supplement, refinish operation, and calibration need scope to collision repair coordinator.
